_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally null or empty.
description: A larger area of blood under the skin caused by bleeding from small vessels, commonly after trauma.
causes: Blunt trauma or bleeding beneath the skin

appearance.general: A flat area of red, purple, blue, or yellow-brown discoloration that changes as it resolves.

warning_signs: Large spontaneous bruises, rapidly increasing bruising, or bruising with other bleeding should be medically assessed.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recent trauma and any medicines that affect bleeding.
